title: Update CLI MCP and Hermes surfaces

context.summary: Expose the multimodal document pipeline through CLI, MCP and Hermes adapter HTTP-facing surfaces.
context.background: TASK-37 through TASK-49 add model runtime, derived artifacts, routing, recompute, artifact search, faces and richer job status. Existing adapter surfaces still mostly cover the earlier text MVP.

in: Add CLI commands for artifact search, document artifact listing/reprocess/status flows, metadata filters and face identity operations where API support already exists.
Add MCP tools for artifact search, document artifacts/status/reprocess, metadata filters and face identity operations without direct DB/Redis/storage access.
Extend Hermes adapter surface helpers for artifact search, document reprocess/status and face identity operations through HTTP API calls.
Update smoke tests/validators for CLI, MCP and Hermes command/tool surfaces.
Update docs for CLI, MCP and Hermes adapter usage.
out: Adding new backend APIs beyond thin surface wiring.
Changing artifact schema or worker pipeline behavior.

acceptance_criteria: CLI exposes upload/status/reprocess/job/artifact search and face operations over HTTP API.
MCP exposes upload/search/memory/context/job plus artifact search, reprocess/status and face tools over HTTP API.
Hermes adapter has HTTP-facing helpers for artifact search, document status/reprocess and face identity operations.
Metadata filters can be passed through CLI and MCP search surfaces.
Smoke tests cover representative CLI, MCP and Hermes calls.
No surface bypasses API by reading DB, Redis or storage directly.

manual_checks: Confirm CLI/MCP/Hermes surfaces use HTTP API clients only.

risks: The backend has artifact search but not a dedicated artifact list API; document artifact listing may need to remain status/processing-run metadata until a backend task adds it.
Hermes real runtime behavior still depends on external Hermes hooks beyond this repository smoke surface.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
